topic: Your brain's best guess 2: Deep talk is less awkward than you expect
caption:
Deep talk is less awkward than you expect.

The prediction: a deeper conversation with someone new would feel awkward.

In experiments, strangers who talked about personal topics found it less awkward and more connecting than they expected. People tended to underestimate how interested others would be in their thoughts and feelings.

Something to try: next chat, you could swap one small-talk question for a curious one.

Your brain's best guess is our series on everyday predictions that research suggests are often too pessimistic. Studies were mostly with US participants, so results may differ for you.

Research: Kardas, M., Kumar, A., & Epley, N. (2022). Overly shallow?: Miscalibrated expectations create a barrier to deeper conversation. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 122(3), 367-398. https://doi.org/10.1037/pspa0000281
